public_scope: Original reviewed final-F facts, actual author manifest/admission chain, actual independent PASS, formal bundle, truthful failed lifecycle and supported completion successor.
private_payload_exclusions: identity ledger and native provider sessions
raw reviewer invocation, supplemental parser/raw reservation payloads and sequence
private author delivery-inputs and older review-only source/controller inputs
raw diagnostic logs/ZIPs represented by existing exact external indexes

raw_patch_exclusions.reason: Original unified diff contains whitespace-bearing context markers. Preserve exact private bytes; raw patch is not acceptance/report-Outputs authority and is excluded from Git. Original failed lifecycle results/commands/logs and before snapshots remain public.
